banner.message: Live demo, fictional data, resets at {{time}}

readOnly.tooltip: Read-only in the demo. Install {{brand}} to try this for real.
readOnly.toast: Read-only demo: this action is not available here

login.title: Explore the demo
login.description: Sign in as a read-only visitor to look around a seeded instance. Nothing you do is saved.
login.humanCheckFailed: Human verification failed. Reload the page and try again.
login.rateLimited: Too many demo sessions from your network. Wait a minute and try again.
login.failed: Could not start the demo. Try again in a moment.

unavailable.title: Not available in the demo
unavailable.generic: This feature needs a real host, so it is switched off in the demo.
unavailable.installHint: Install {{brand}} on your own server to use it.

empty.title: Nothing here in the demo
empty.description: This area is intentionally empty in the demo data. On a real instance it fills in as you use {{brand}}.

apps.title: Apps
apps.body: See every app, its deploys and one-click rollbacks.

databases.title: Databases
databases.body: Find the connection string and the backups for each database.

domains.title: Domains
domains.body: Add a domain and get HTTPS certificates automatically.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.body: Servers, devices and AWS machines in one fleet view.

finish.title: Like what you see?
finish.body: Star the project on GitHub or install it in one line.

install.title: Install in one line
install.description: Run it on your own server. Nothing from this demo carries over.

steps.run: Run the command on a Linux server or your laptop.
steps.open: Open the URL it prints and create your admin account.
steps.deploy: Deploy your first app from a Git repo or an image.

installState.title: Available when you install
installState.description: This feature needs a real server, so the demo shows it as a preview only. Install {{brand}} on your own host to use it with your apps.

chat.hint: Canned replies to show how the assistant answers. Install to connect your own model and ask about your apps.
chat.empty: Pick a question to see a sample answer.

replies.crashloop: Sample reply: I read the last 200 log lines and the container exit codes. The process exits with code 1 right after start because a required variable is missing. Set it in the app environment and redeploy.
replies.slow: Sample reply: I compared CPU, memory and request latency for the last hour. Latency rises with memory use near the limit. Raising the memory limit or adding a replica should help.
replies.rollback: Sample reply: I would propose a rollback to the previous healthy deploy and wait for your approval before changing anything. Changes always need your confirmation.

terminal.hint: A sample shell session. Install to open a real terminal inside your own containers.
terminal.label: Sample terminal transcript

database.hint: A sample query and result. Install to run SQL against your own databases.

app.hint: A sample result. Nothing was created. Install to deploy this app for real.

db.hint: A sample result. No database was created. Install to create one on your own server.
db.masked: The password is masked. A real database shows its own connection string.

env.hint: A sample preview. Nothing was saved. Install to manage the environment of your own apps.
env.redeploy: A redeploy would start now to apply the new values (sample).

scale.hint: A sample preview. The app is not changed. Install to scale your own apps.

steps.health: Wait for health checks to pass
steps.route: Route traffic to the new replicas

dns.hint: A sample result. No DNS lookup ran. Install to check your own domains.

logs.hint: This app has no logs in the demo. These lines are a sample of what a running app prints.
logs.label: Sample app logs
